description.value:
You don't die on schedule. Someone is covering the difference.

Gift — When reduced to 0 HP you may choose to remain standing and act normally until the end of your next turn before you drop. Tithe — It is being paid for and the debt is tracked. Once per session the GM may collect without a save — an ally's healing, a prepared resource, or a scene's worth of your luck goes somewhere else, and you are told only afterwards.

cinderfall.incomplete: "When reduced to 0 HP you may choose to remain standing and act normally until the end of your next turn before you drop" has no confirmed rule-element hook: it overrides pf2e's built-in dying/unconsciousness sequence at 0 HP, and no rule element for delaying that sequence by a full turn was found in pf2e-source.
